intlcost.title: UWM Center for International Education - Fees & Scholarships

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class); international means the 'Nonresidents' residency row (2,034 applied, 1,227 admitted, 40 enrolled). In-state counts include students of unknown residency (a note in the Common Data Set). UWM did not report SAT/ACT percentiles or the share of students who sent scores, because scores are self-reported. Undergraduate enrollment is 19,207 and nonresident undergraduates number 383 (fall 2025). No early decision or early action; no waitlist.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: UWM international cost page (2026-27, two semesters): nonresident tuition $22,247 plus segregated and international student fees $2,158; page estimate of $41,663 includes $15,000 living expenses (12 months) and $2,258 international health insurance (12 months). The Common Data Set (2024-25 aid) shows 152 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $4,117. A $200 International Student Processing Fee is due after admission
